tags.Usage: WhatsApp Generative-AI chatbot on AWS with Bedrock AgentCore Runtime + Strands Agents + optional Cognito Auth Portal

dev.comment_secret: IMPORTANT: the secret MUST be created manually BEFORE the first deployment (see GETTING_STARTED.md). Keys: AWS_API_KEY_TOKEN, META_TOKEN, META_FROM_PHONE_NUMBER_ID
dev.comment_dns: MANDATORY PREREQUISITE: you MUST own a Route53 Hosted Zone. REPLACE <hosted_zone_name> and <hosted_zone_id> below with YOUR OWN zone values (and adjust the subdomains if desired). The current values are the author's defaults and will NOT work in your AWS account
dev.comment_auth: When <auth_enabled> is false, the Auth Portal Stack (Cognito, CloudFront, Auth API, auth-sessions table) is NOT deployed and the State Machine bypasses auth (all users are incognito). The demo users password and the main demo phone number come from the local <.env> file (see .env.example)
dev.comment_agentcore: AgentCore Runtime with Strands Agent deployed via direct code deploy (ZIP). Model configured below (Bedrock cross-region inference profile)
